SettingsView.description: Manage your workspace, team, billing, and notification preferences.
SettingsView.title: Settings

SettingsShared.accessDenied: Ask an admin to grant your role access to this section of Settings.
SettingsShared.checkDetails: Please check the details and try again.

SettingsProfile.resetDescription: Clear all data across every workspace and restore the original demo defaults. This includes invoices, employees, deals, and company information. This action cannot be undone and will sign everyone out, including you.

SettingsResetDemo.description: This wipes and reseeds the entire database — invoices, employees, deals, and company information — for every user. It cannot be undone, and it will immediately end every active session, including your own. You will be signed out.
SettingsResetDemo.success: Demo data reset. Signing you out…
SettingsResetDemo.successDescription: Every session, including yours, was just invalidated.
SettingsResetDemo.title: Reset all demo data?

SettingsTeam.cannotDeactivateSelf: You can't deactivate your own account
SettingsTeam.title: Team Members

SettingsDeactivateMember.description: Their account will be marked inactive and every active session or API token they hold is revoked immediately. This does not delete their history — audit, invoice, and approval records referencing them are preserved.
SettingsDeactivateMember.title: Deactivate {name}?

SettingsInviteMember.description: They'll get an email to set their own password — no password is generated or shown here.
SettingsInviteMember.roleHint: A role appearing here doesn't guarantee you can grant it — the server still enforces your own permission ceiling.
SettingsInviteMember.roleRequired: Select a role for this member
SettingsInviteMember.successDescription: The new member will receive an email to set their password.
SettingsInviteMember.title: Invite Team Member

SettingsRoles.accessDenied: Only an HR Admin (or a role with roles = write) can view or edit role permissions.
SettingsRoles.levelTooHigh: You can't grant a level higher than you have
SettingsRoles.selectRole: Select a role to view and edit its permission matrix.
SettingsRoles.title: Roles

SettingsBilling.noSubscription: No active subscription. Choose a plan to get started.
SettingsBilling.updatePaymentHint: Requires client-side card tokenization via a payment provider SDK — not wired up yet
SettingsBilling.updatePaymentToast: Payment method updates aren't wired up yet
SettingsBilling.updatePaymentToastDescription: This endpoint only accepts a provider token (Stripe/Paymob/Fawry) — it never accepts a raw card number. Client-side tokenization is out of scope for this change.

SettingsChangePlan.description: Your next billing date resets to the first of next month on the new plan.
SettingsChangePlan.title: Change Plan

SettingsNotifications.description: Choose what you want to be notified about
SettingsNotifications.title: Notification Preferences
